title: Radio: John Lennon on WPLJ-FM | 1975
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to WPLJ-FM in New York City 2 March 1975.

It was an impromptu appearance. At around 5:30am the early morning presenter Alex Bennett received a call from chauffeur Ronnie Sunshine, who informed Bennett that Lennon, Yoko Ono, and David Bowie were on the line.

Bennett spoke to the trio for around 10 minutes, with the call broadcast live.

Page last updated: 23 April 2026
